name: GeeksCAT Conf 2026
description: The unconference of geeks for geeks in Girona, Catalonia. Talks, debates, and community.

tools.name: get_agenda
tools.description: Returns the complete conference schedule (sessions, timings, titles, speakers, and abstracts) for GeeksCAT 2026 in Girona.

tools.name: get_speakers
tools.description: Returns the list of confirmed speakers for GeeksCAT 2026, including their bio, talk topics, and social links.

speaker_slug.description: Optional speaker slug to get a single speaker (e.g. 'jordi-mas', 'dario-castane', 'andrey-sitnik').

tools.name: get_conference_info
tools.description: Returns key conference details: date (26 September 2026), location (Girona, Catalonia), ticket sales, venue, and Code of Conduct.
